title: Winery tour was a highlight
text: We did the day tour which included lunch at the winery which was delicious. Mayi our guide was awesome very knowledgeable on the area and the wines on offer at the winery . Totally recommend.
author: 590KathrynW

title: Great tour with a great tour guide!
text: What a way to spend the day!  Bus was clean and comfortable, train ride to Montserrat was quick and full of great views, winery tour was fun, and Anays was the perfect tour guide.  She was very knowledgeable of the culture and history and shared tidbits about every stop along the way.  We walked to the cross, about twenty minutes there and about 15 minutes back, and pictures from that point were amazing!  Anays was very knowledgeable of  the wine process and explained everything in great detail. Highly recommend!!!

title: I loved all of it especially the guide and the cheese!
text:
I went to the amazing mountains and walked on an amazing trail. The views the guide and the tastings were spectacular. Most of all I loved our tour guide. Her name was Kyra she spoke English so well and had amazing suggestions. She always knew what to do and how to help. She was hilarious and a fantastic guide.
This was an amazing day and Kyra was the one person who made it even better.
